value.rationale: Half congruences obstruct invertible rack quotients. The theorem classifies every such obstruction in a canonical countable two-generated quandle, describes all quotient functional digraphs and the full distributive lattice, and exhibits a sharp separation: all nontrivial proper finitely generated one-sided congruences are half congruences, while all finite quotients are true quandles. These are natural structural invariants and boundaries, not arbitrary parameter slices.
